scope: Exact on-disk curated vehicle order for run_1 and run_2 at k=40,000; not a population estimate for the 435-case training split.
warnings: The fill-distance metric is exact only on a frozen 2,000-cell query subset, not on every surface cell.
Simple-random sampling is a diagnostic comparator, not the production sampler.
Four starts/seeds per scheme characterize these two cases only.
